verdict.rationale: Docs describe a full checkout/payment-acceptance flow: provisioning stable onchain addresses that auto-credit a custodial account, a two-step auth/capture checkout API with developer control over auth timing, partial captures and voids, plus migration guidance from the older Commerce Charge API to the newer Checkouts API with settlement details. This covers create-payment, present-address/flow, and confirm-settlement programmatically. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer confirmation of the checkout flow working end-to-end, and no concrete code sample or OpenAPI spec (probe found openapi.json 404) showing the settlement confirmation call.
